nodes.label: Photosynthesis
nodes.summary: Plants convert light energy into chemical energy stored in sugars.

nodes.label: Chlorophyll
nodes.summary: A green pigment in chloroplasts that absorbs red and blue light.

nodes.label: Light Reactions
nodes.summary: Light-dependent reactions split water and produce ATP and NADPH.

nodes.label: Calvin Cycle
nodes.summary: Uses ATP and NADPH to fix carbon dioxide into sugar in the stroma.

nodes.label: Oxygen Release
nodes.summary: Splitting water releases oxygen as a by-product.

nodes.label: Stomata
nodes.summary: Leaf pores that admit carbon dioxide and release oxygen and water vapour.

nodes.label: Glucose
nodes.summary: The sugar plants build from the Calvin cycle's three-carbon product.
